briefings.title: Q&A: Trump's plunging ratings, Vance vs Rubio & Israel without Bibi? | Christiane Amanpour Presents
briefings.channel: Christiane Amanpour Presents: The Ex Files
briefings.tldr: The Trump administration is attempting to pivot from military escalation in the Middle East toward a face-saving diplomatic "victory" before high-level talks with China, even as the conflict’s ripple effects threaten to push 30 million people into poverty across Africa.

briefings.title: Fmr. National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan on China, the U.S. & the AI Race | Amanpour and Company
briefings.tldr: The United States and China are engaged in a high-stakes race for AI supremacy that mirrors the Cold War’s nuclear and space races, requiring the U.S. to balance aggressive private-sector innovation with stringent export controls and sustained diplomatic safety talks.
